visual_action: A split-screen video. On the left, under the word 'TALKING', is a montage of clips of Donald Trump speaking at various events. On the right, under the word 'DELIVERING', is a single, continuous clip of Joe Biden sitting at a desk outdoors, signing a document. He is surrounded by a group of people, including Kamala Harris, who are watching and clapping.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown on the left side of the split screen in multiple clips, speaking about infrastructure. The audio is composed entirely of his voice.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Shown on the right side of the split screen, signing a document, positioned as the one who is 'delivering'.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Visible standing behind Joe Biden as he signs the document.

cast.name: Thomas R Carper
cast.evidence: Visible in the crowd of people behind Joe Biden.

spoken_summary: The audio is a montage of clips of Donald Trump speaking about infrastructure. He says things like, "We'll talk about infrastructure," "pass a one trillion dollar infrastructure plan," "who's better at infrastructure than Trump," and "I want to rebuild our infrastructure." The audio then devolves into a rapid-fire, layered repetition of just the word "infrastructure" over and over.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of edited speech clips of Donald Trump. There is no music. The editing creates a repetitive and increasingly fast-paced soundscape focused on the word 'infrastructure' to create a sense of empty rhetoric.
editing_pacing: The video uses a split-screen format. The left side features a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between different clips of Donald Trump. The right side is a single, static shot of Joe Biden signing a document.
central_claim: Donald Trump only talked about passing an infrastructure bill, while Joe Biden successfully delivered one.
intended_effect: To portray Joe Biden as an effective president who follows through on promises, in contrast to Donald Trump, who is depicted as all talk and no action.
